question: Gopal Prasad Dubey won Padma Shri in which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhau.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gopal Prasad Dubey **won **Padma Shri** in** Chhau dance** form.
 
• Chhau is a traditional dance form originated in eastern India, mainly in the states of **Jharkhand, Odisha, and West Bengal.**
 
• Chhau dance is performed duri
